comment: The passes of the HD-2D look (D-849). The tilt-shift blur and the vignette draw on every map and every fight, above the fog and the light shafts and under the marks and the UI (D-919, D-920). The mode is smooth or stepped, and it sets the blur, the vignette, and the light shafts together: the stepped mode fades in the steps over blocks of the cell size in art pixels, as the fog does (D-907, D-917). The owner reads both modes and picks one. The blur band is the height of the band of blur at the top and at the bottom of the view, and the blur radius is the blur at the edge of the view, in art pixels. The vignette darkens to its palette key, from the start, a part of the way from the middle of the view to a corner, to its strength at the corners, in basis points.
